_comment: Growable collection of KNOWN INFRASTRUCTURE error signatures. Events matching any regex (case-insensitive, DOTALL over the full traceback) are classified 'infrastructure' and are NOT investigated by the agent — they are filed straight to done/ with an audit_log.md line. When the agent root-causes an 'unknown' event as infrastructure, it MUST append the signature here (see .agents/skills/fleet-error-monitor/SKILL.md). Never add a pattern that could mask a code bug — signatures must be specific to connectivity/gateway failures.

patterns.name: ibkr-connectivity-lost
patterns.regex: Connectivity between IB(KR)? and (the )?Trader Workstation has been lost|error 1100
patterns.notes: IBKR error 1100 — TWS/Gateway lost its connection to IBKR servers. Self-heals on 1101/1102; not fixable in code.

patterns.name: gateway-unreachable
patterns.regex: ConnectionRefusedError|\[WinError 10061\]|Couldn't connect to TWS|API connection failed
patterns.notes: TWS/IB Gateway is not running or not listening on the configured port. Start/restart the gateway.

patterns.name: connection-reset
patterns.regex: ConnectionResetError|\[WinError 10054\]|Connection reset by peer|Peer closed connection
patterns.notes: Gateway dropped the socket mid-session (restart, network flap, daily auto-restart window).

patterns.name: connect-timeout
patterns.notes: Timeout during the IBKR connect handshake specifically (NOT a blanket TimeoutError match — a generic timeout elsewhere may be a code bug).

patterns.name: data-farm-broken
patterns.regex: Market data farm connection is broken|HMDS data farm connection is broken|Historical Market Data Service error
patterns.notes: IBKR-side data farm outage (errors 2110/2103/162 family). Recovers server-side.

patterns.name: socket-disconnect
patterns.notes: ib_insync detected the API socket dropping — infra-side unless it correlates with a code change.

patterns.name: ibkr-connect-refused-1225
patterns.regex: Could not connect to IBKR on any port|\[WinError 1225\]
patterns.notes: The ibkr_client.connect() re-raise (ConnectionError, not ConnectionRefusedError — the old gateway-unreachable regex missed it) when the gateway is not listening on any candidate port. WinError 1225 = remote refused. Seen 2026-07-21 21:04-21:19 PT: fleet relaunched during a deploy before the gateway was back up; all 5 children exhausted restart caps, runner exited, 21:21:40 relaunch succeeded. gave_up:true on these still means the fleet was DOWN at the time — the watchdog report must say whether it is back.
